title: The eMudhra Certificate Authority Compromise: What It Means for TeamCity
summary: Summary In October 2026, the private keys of eight intermediate certificate authorities operated by eMudhra were found to be weak and recoverable from public data. According to eMudhra’s official statement, none of the affected intermediate CAs had issued end-entity (leaf) certificates, and eMudhra is not aware of evidence that the weak keys were recovered or exploited before the issue was disclosed.
